info.name: Webhook.site API
info.description:
Collection for Webhook.site API endpoints including requests, tokens, and URL management.

In this folder, you can customize the API Key under the Variables tab – or turn off authorization entirely under the Authorization tab.

View the complete documentation here: [https://docs.webhook.site/api/about.html](https://docs.webhook.site/api/about.html)

item.description:
Endpoints for managing Webhook.site Tokens/URLs.

In Webhook.site parlance, "tokens" act as the inbox or container for Requests, Emails and DNSHooks and correspond to a Webhook.site URL or E-mail Address.

request.description:
Create a new template containing Custom Actions. Templates can be reused across different workflows using the Include Template action.

**Parameters:**
- `name`: The name of the template
- `actions`: Array of Custom Action objects (all parameters except `disabled` can be used)
- `variables`: Array of name-value objects for predefined variables available to subsequent actions

Requires authentication.

item.name: Users

request.description:
Sends a user invite to the specified email address

If part of a SSO-enabled Webhook.site Team, the user is sent a login URL where they can log in immediately. Otherwise, they are sent a link to a page where they can set up their profile and password.

- `name` (string) The name of the user.
    
- `email` (string) The user's email, and where the invite is sent.
    
- `user_type_id` (int) One of: 100 (Administrator), 200 (Member), 300 (Viewer)
Retrieves information about the currently authenticated user.

Updates the profile information of the authenticated user.
Deletes the user with the specified ID
